$.notes: The LOC six-point dollar before 2468, at threshold 155, retains both native apertures and the printed bar and terminal extents. Twelve independent capitals and ten flat-footed text anchors support scale and row alignment. The filled collective dollar and threshold 110 with a broken lower contour are rejected. Modern 35-unit sidebearings are used; no punctuation is invented. Four-times Lanczos sampling preserves the native evidence; no hole filling or independent stretching is applied.
